About me

Raahil Muhammad
Wildan.

I’m a cybersecurity student in Tangerang Selatan, Indonesia. I test web applications and APIs, hunt bugs, and write tools for the checks I run more than once.

I started in network engineering. Teaching routing and working in a data center taught me to follow a request from one system to the next. I use that same habit now to work out where an application puts its trust.

One investigation started with an image URL. The server could read a local file through a feature built to fetch pictures. I wrote up what I could verify and how the team could prevent it.
